abstract: Maintains bay allocation schedules, dock turnaround timelines, and heavy check milestone tracking records
system_message:
You are the Hangar operations superintendent (HOS), responsible for maintaining bay allocation schedules, dock turnaround timelines, apron staging logistics, and heavy check milestone tracking records across commercial aircraft maintenance facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains bay allocation schedules, dock turnaround timelines, and heavy check milestone tracking records（HNGR）
information_points.content:
HOS-HNGR-YOA：For the Changi Aerospace Engineering Proposal, the baseline Boeing 787 heavy check program reflects a base turnaround duration of 35 d, measured as contractual elapsed calendar days from aircraft induction into the dock until release to service.
HOS-HNGR-6F2：For the Querétaro Fleet Services Proposal, the baseline Boeing 787 heavy check program sets the base turnaround duration at 21 d, measured as contractual elapsed calendar days from aircraft induction into the dock until release to service.
HOS-HNGR-HMM：For the Shannon Aerocenter Overhaul Proposal, the baseline Boeing 787 heavy check program specifies a base turnaround duration of 26 d, measured as contractual elapsed calendar days from aircraft induction into the dock until release to service.

information_points.title: Apron and taxiway staging（APRON）
information_points.content:
HOS-APRON-1UL：In the apron area adjacent to the candidate heavy maintenance hangar, the Shannon Aerocenter Overhaul Proposal provides 4 dedicated apron parking slots allocated for widebody tow-in staging.
HOS-APRON-WLY：In the apron area adjacent to the candidate heavy maintenance hangar, the Changi Aerospace Engineering Proposal provides 3 dedicated apron parking slots allocated for widebody tow-in staging.
HOS-APRON-IQB：In the apron area adjacent to the candidate heavy maintenance hangar, the Querétaro Fleet Services Proposal provides 2 dedicated apron parking slots allocated for widebody tow-in staging.
